description: Email DNS Deliverability Auditor API: Audit MX, SPF 10-lookup limits, DMARC, DKIM, BIMI, and MTA-STS with a 0–100 score. (Endpoint: POST /v1/email-dns)

dkim_selectors.description: Optional custom DKIM selectors to probe in addition to common defaults.

domain.description: Domain name or email address to audit (e.g. 'tinplate.dev' or 'hello@tinplate.dev').

records.description: Optional pre-fetched DNS records for offline auditing without live DNS-over-HTTPS queries.

name: tinplate_email_dns
